'''GEMP sealed league products''' are the card products that [[GEMP]] gives each player in a sealed league. Each sealed league type has a product list for each series of the league.<ref name="slp">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/league/SealedLeagueProduct.java SealedLeagueProduct.java], GEMP source code (billbisco/swccg-gemp, commit 16168b26), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021124632/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/billbisco/swccg-gemp/ec48dc19/SealedLeagueProduct.java.html Internet Archive]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022042347/https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/league/SealedLeagueProduct.java Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="slt">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/league/SealedLeagueType.java SealedLeagueType.java], GEMP source code (billbisco/swccg-gemp, commit 16168b26), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021114842/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/billbisco/swccg-gemp/ec48dc19/SealedLeagueType.java.html Internet Archive]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022041239/https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/league/SealedLeagueType.java Internet Archive].</ref>

== How product is issued ==
A sealed league has as many series as its product list has entries; every sealed league type on GEMP has two. A player who joins gets the product of every series that has already started. When a later series starts, every player in the league gets that series' product.<ref name="nsld">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/league/NewSealedLeagueData.java NewSealedLeagueData.java], GEMP source code (billbisco/swccg-gemp, commit 16168b26), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021124352/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/billbisco/swccg-gemp/ec48dc19/NewSealedLeagueData.java.html Internet Archive]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022042314/https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/league/NewSealedLeagueData.java Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="slp" />

Some lists also add one random card from each of four location pools: Dark Side sites, Dark Side systems, Light Side sites and Light Side systems.<ref name="slp" /> A product whose name starts with "(S)" is a selection pack: the player must choose one of the packs it lists before opening it.<ref name="crh">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-async/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/async/handler/CollectionRequestHandler.java CollectionRequestHandler.java], GEMP source code (billbisco/swccg-gemp, commit 16168b26), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021130827/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/billbisco/swccg-gemp/ec48dc19/CollectionRequestHandler.java.html Internet Archive]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022042240/https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-async/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/async/handler/CollectionRequestHandler.java Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="fpb">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/packagedProduct/FixedPackBox.java FixedPackBox.java], GEMP source code (billbisco/swccg-gemp, commit 16168b26), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021131618/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/billbisco/swccg-gemp/ec48dc19/FixedPackBox.java.html Internet Archive]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022042951/https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/packagedProduct/FixedPackBox.java Internet Archive].</ref> In the two Watto's Cube types, the cards a player receives exclude duplicates across packs.<ref name="nsld" />

Every GEMP sealed format sets a deck size of 40 cards.<ref name="gemp">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/swccgFormats.json swccgFormats.json], GEMP source code (billbisco/swccg-gemp, commit 16168b26), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021114513/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/billbisco/swccg-gemp/ec48dc19/swccgFormats.json.html Internet Archive]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022040117/https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/swccgFormats.json Internet Archive].</ref>

== Products by league type ==

=== [[Premiere - A New Hope Sealed]] ===
League type <code>premiere_anh_sealed</code>, format <code>premiere_anh_sealed</code>.<ref name="slt" />

* Series 1: 1 × Jedi Pack, 1 × [[Official Tournament Sealed Deck]], 4 × Premiere Booster Pack, 1 × A New Hope Booster Pack.<ref name="slp" />
** Fixed cards (10): Dark Side: [[Death Star: Docking Control Room 327]], [[Vader (Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game)|Vader]], [[Vader's Obsession]], [[Tentacle]], [[There'll Be Hell To Pay]]; Light Side: [[Death Star: Level 6 Core Shaft Corridor]], [[Luke (Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game)|Luke]], [[Run Luke, Run!]], [[Grappling Hook (PC Errata)|Grappling Hook]], [[What're You Tryin' To Push On Us?]].<ref name="slp" /><ref name="cardjson" />
* Series 2: 2 × Premiere Booster Pack, 4 × A New Hope Booster Pack.<ref name="slp" />

=== [[Jabba's Palace Sealed]] ===
League type <code>jp_sealed</code>, format <code>jp_sealed</code>.<ref name="slt" />

* Series 1: 1 × [[Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]], 6 × Jabba's Palace Booster Pack.<ref name="slp" />
* Series 2: 1 × selection pack ''Enhanced Jabba's Palace Pack Choice'' (the player picks one of the packs it lists)<ref name="fpb" /><ref name="crh" />.<ref name="slp" />

=== [[Endor - Death Star II Sealed]] ===
League type <code>endor_dsII_sealed</code>, format <code>endor_dsII_sealed</code>.<ref name="slt" />

* Series 1: 1 × Death Star II Pre-Constructed Deck - Dark, 1 × Death Star II Pre-Constructed Deck - Light, 4 × Endor Booster Pack (no random foils).<ref name="slp" />
* Series 2: 4 × Death Star II Booster Pack.<ref name="slp" />

== Differences from the Players Committee GEMP ==
The [[GEMP]] code behind [https://play.swccg.com/ play.swccg.com]<ref name="play">[https://play.swccg.com/ play.swccg.com], GEMP. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009095947/https://play.swccg.com/ Internet Archive].</ref> (billbisco/swccg-gemp, commit 16168b26) differs from the Players Committee repository (PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public, commit 5e26dd19) in these sealed league details:<ref name="slp" /><ref name="pc-slp">[https://github.com/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/blob/5e26dd19cc700adbf77de53e0d7b89720c94f03e/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/league/SealedLeagueProduct.java SealedLeagueProduct.java], GEMP source code (PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public, commit 5e26dd19), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021125620/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/5e26dd19/SealedLeagueProduct.java.html Internet Archive].</ref>
* '''Premiere - A New Hope Sealed''', series 1: the Players Committee code issues 2 Official Tournament Sealed Decks. This code issues 1 Official Tournament Sealed Deck plus 4 Premiere and 1 A New Hope Booster Packs. Both come to 8 Premiere and 2 A New Hope Booster Packs. This code gives one copy of the Official Tournament Sealed Deck set (GEMP set 106) instead of two.<ref name="slp" /><ref name="pc-slp" /><ref name="k-OfficialTournamentSealedDeck" />
* '''Jabba's Palace Sealed''', series 1: the Players Committee code issues 2 Jabba's Palace Sealed Decks; this code issues 1 Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck plus 6 Jabba's Palace Booster Packs. Both give 12 Jabba's Palace Booster Packs in total, but only one copy of the Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck cards.<ref name="slp" /><ref name="pc-slp" /><ref name="k-JabbasPalaceSealedDeck" />
* '''Reflections Sealed''': the Players Committee location pools also include 13 Episode I locations (Dark Side sites: [[Naboo: Theed Palace Courtyard (Dark)|Naboo: Theed Palace Courtyard]], [[Naboo: Theed Palace Throne Room (Dark)|Naboo: Theed Palace Throne Room]], [[Tatooine: Mos Espa (Dark)|Tatooine: Mos Espa]], [[Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard (Dark)|Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard]]; Dark Side systems: [[Coruscant (Dark) (Coruscant)|Coruscant]], [[Malastare (Dark)|Malastare]], [[Tatooine (Dark) (Coruscant)|Tatooine]]; Light Side sites: [[Naboo: Theed Palace Courtyard]], [[Naboo: Theed Palace Throne Room]], [[Tatooine: Mos Espa]]; Light Side systems: [[Coruscant (Light) (Coruscant)|Coruscant]], [[Malastare]], [[Tatooine (Light) (Coruscant)|Tatooine]]). This code leaves them out.<ref name="slp" /><ref name="pc-slp" /><ref name="cardjson" />
* '''League formats''': the Players Committee code plays most sealed league types under the generic [[Sealed]] or [[Cube]] format. This code gives each league type its own format with the same name, such as [[Reflections Sealed]] or [[Watto's Cube with fixed pack Cube]].<ref name="pc-slt">[https://github.com/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/blob/5e26dd19cc700adbf77de53e0d7b89720c94f03e/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/league/SealedLeagueType.java SealedLeagueType.java], GEMP source code (PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public, commit 5e26dd19), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021125714/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/5e26dd19/SealedLeagueType.java.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="slt" /><ref name="gemp" /><ref name="pc-gemp">[https://github.com/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/blob/5e26dd19cc700adbf77de53e0d7b89720c94f03e/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/swccgFormats.json swccgFormats.json], GEMP source code (PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public, commit 5e26dd19), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021130403/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/5e26dd19/swccgFormats.json.html Internet Archive].</ref>
* '''Duplicates''': both codes exclude duplicate cards across packs in the generic Cube league format; this code also does so for the two Watto's Cube formats.<ref name="nsld" /><ref name="pc-nsld">[https://github.com/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/blob/5e26dd19cc700adbf77de53e0d7b89720c94f03e/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/league/NewSealedLeagueData.java NewSealedLeagueData.java], GEMP source code (PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public, commit 5e26dd19), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021125522/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/5e26dd19/NewSealedLeagueData.java.html Internet Archive].</ref>
* '''Names''': the Players Committee format list names the <code>jp_sealed</code> format "JP Sealed"; this code names it "Jabba's Palace Sealed".<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="pc-gemp" />
